channel.title: Hermes Atlas — new projects
channel.description: Newly added community-built tools, skills, plugins, and integrations for Nous Research's Hermes Agent. Updated daily.

item.title: agentiker-code-intel (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: agentiker-code-intel is a Hermes plugin providing AST-aware code intelligence through tree-sitter, ast-grep, and LSP integration. It includes 70 tools for tasks such as symbol extraction, structural search, and impact analysis.

item.title: china-briefing (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: China Briefing is a multi-scale Chinese news briefing generator designed for Hermes Agent. It generates structured reports ranging from global to street-level geographic scales using Tavily API for web searches.

item.title: agentcairn (Memory & Context)
item.description: Agentcairn provides a durable Markdown-based memory system for coding agents. It uses a replaceable DuckDB index for retrieval and supports multiple agent hosts through plugins or MCP.

item.title: sourcevault-code-tools (Memory & Context)
item.description: This Hermes Agent plugin provides semantic code search, file reading, and grounded Q&A for local codebases. It functions as a client that requires a local SourceVault backend to perform indexing and retrieval.

item.title: perseus (Memory & Context)
item.description: Perseus is a memory and context layer for AI agents that resolves live workspace state into facts before the context window opens. It implements the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to provide tools for assistants like Claude Desktop and Cursor.

item.title: piprail (Memory & Context)
item.description: PipRail is an implementation of the x402 "402 Payment Required" standard designed for agentic payments. It provides a TypeScript SDK and an MCP server to facilitate direct wallet-to-wallet transactions across multiple blockchain families.

item.title: hermes-live-discord-agent-plugin (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: This plugin enables full-duplex voice interaction between Discord and the Google Gemini Multimodal Live API. It supports vision via screenshare or images, function calling for various tools, and provides automated transcripts and idle hangup functionality.

item.title: contentforge (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: ContentForge is an open-source enterprise content production pipeline that utilizes a 10-phase workflow to generate.docx files. The system includes specialized agents for fact-checking, humanizing text, and managing internal linking.

item.title: space0-mcp (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: space0 provides a shared 3D voxel world that enables agents to utilize spatial memory. It functions as a remote MCP server where agent identity is tied to a bearer key.

item.title: superpowers (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: Superpowers is a software development methodology for coding agents built on a set of composable skills. It uses a subagent-driven-development process to execute implementation plans through automated tasks and reviews.

item.title: openInvest (Domain Applications)
item.description: OpenInvest is a self-hosted investment decision engine designed to be integrated into modern AI agents. It utilizes a multi-agent coordinator-worker architecture to provide verifiable investment committees, evidence-based reasoning, and auditable decision trails.

item.title: nora (Deployment & Infra)
item.description: Nora is a self-hosted platform for deploying, monitoring, and operating OpenClaw and Hermes AI agent fleets. It supports agent lifecycle management on Docker or Kubernetes and provides tools for secrets management, monitoring, and scheduling.

item.title: nika (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: Nika is a workflow language for AI that uses a single file to define a graph of model calls, tools, and processes. The reference engine is a single Rust binary that performs static audits on workflows before execution to verify costs, permissions, and types.

item.title: Sibyl-Memory (Memory & Context)
item.description: Sibyl-Memory is a file-based agentic memory infrastructure that uses a SQLite-backed, five-tier hierarchical schema. It provides a suite of five PyPI packages including an SDK, CLI, MCP server, Hermes adapter, and a LangGraph BaseStore adapter. The system operates without vector databases or embedding models.

item.title: internet-court-skill (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: Internet Court is an open skill designed for agent-to-agent contracts that includes adjudication for dispute resolution. The repository provides a master router, connector skills, and vendored copies of official protocol skills to manage the lifecycle of a deal.

item.title: fablize-for-hermes (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: fablize-for-hermes is a port of the fablize procedure system designed to improve task completion and verification within the Hermes Agent ecosystem. It implements a structured behavioral ruleset that enforces multi-step task decomposition, evidence-based checkpoints, and systematic investigation protocols for debugging. By utilizing a Python-based goal engine and specific verification packs, the project ensures agents ground their claims in tool results rather than ending tasks prematurely. This

item.title: Agentkey (Integrations & Bridges)
item.description: AgentKey is a unified integration layer that provides AI agents with access to external data sources including social media, web scraping, and on-chain crypto data. It uses a single subscription model to replace the need for multiple individual API keys and provider registrations.

item.title: remoteopenclaw-mcp (Skills & Skill Registries)
item.description: Remote OpenClaw MCP Server provides a command-line and agent-native interface for searching a directory of over 13,000 MCP servers and 4,000 agent skills. It functions as a thin TypeScript wrapper around the Remote OpenClaw public search API, allowing agents to retrieve tool metadata and installation commands without a browser. This integration enables agents like Hermes and Claude Code to autonomously discover and suggest relevant plugins for tasks such as database management or web scraping. T

item.title: hermes-penfield (Memory & Context)
item.description: hermes-penfield is a persistent memory provider that enables Hermes Agent to maintain memory across different sessions and agents. It connects the agent to the Penfield memory API using a stdlib-only HTTP implementation with OAuth and API-key authentication. The provider utilizes hybrid search and a knowledge graph with 24 relationship types to manage memories and artifacts. It also automatically saves checkpoints of relevant memories when context compression occurs.

item.title: typeui (Developer Tools)
item.description: TypeUI is an AI-first platform designed to improve the quality of user interfaces generated by large language models. It functions as a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that provides AI coding tools with access to curated design systems, layout variations, and UI-specific prompts. By supplying this structured design guidance, the project helps developers build and refactor websites or applications using plain-language requests. It integrates with a wide range of tools including Hermes Agent,

item.title: hermes-feishu-group-context (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: Hermes Feishu Group Context is a plugin that provides local archiving and on-demand context retrieval for Feishu/Lark group chats. It uses a local SQLite database to store messages, ensuring that model tokens are only consumed when the agent is explicitly triggered. The system automatically injects recent history during empty mentions or provides specific time-range summaries via a dedicated tool. This approach allows the agent to maintain group awareness without processing every message in real

item.title: hermes-tag (Integrations & Bridges)
item.description: Hermes Tag is a context-selection layer for Hermes on Feishu/Lark, Slack, and DingTalk. It retrieves specific images, notes, and relevant replies when @-mentioned to provide bounded evidence without processing entire chat histories.

item.title: observeco (Developer Tools)
item.description: ObserveCo is a local-first observability platform designed to monitor, diagnose, and recover multi-agent AI systems. It operates as a self-hosted service that tracks real-time telemetry, token usage, and memory drift without requiring cloud dependencies. The tool features a beta Hermes Agent plugin that exports detailed hooks for API requests, tool calls, and subagent lifecycles. item.title: agentline-skill (Integrations & Bridges)
item.description: No description

item.title: tiny.place (Developer Tools)
item.description: tiny.place provides a<pad>infrastructure layer for autonomous AI agents to establish identities, communicate, and conduct commerce. The system utilizes a registry for @handle identities, Signal Protocol for encrypted messaging, and Solana for on-chain payment settlement. It enables agents to discover one another through an open directory and transact using USDC and SOL via an x402-compliant facilitator.

item.title: hermes-browser-extension (Workspaces & GUIs)
item.description: A Chromium-based side panel extension that connects to a local, Hermes Cloud, or remote Hermes Agent runtime. It provides browser-native integration for Hermes sessions using a local gateway, Hermes Cloud, or a self-hosted remote API.

item.title: hypernatt-terminal (Integrations & Bridges)
item.description: HyperNatt Terminal provides read-only BTC/USDC decision context for AI agents via an MCP server. It offers tools for vault proofs, market signals, and cross-chain swaps via Li.Fi.

item.title: hermes-xmemo-plugin (Memory & Context)
item.description: The hermes-xmemo-plugin is a native memory provider that gives Hermes Agent durable, cross-session memory. It connects the agent to a user-owned XMemo account to store and retrieve facts, preferences, and working states via semantic search and background prefetching. This allows Hermes to access context saved from other agents, including memories authorized through a ChatGPT bridge. The plugin integrates directly into the Hermes memory lifecycle, supporting native memory mirroring and session sn

item.title: hermes-venice-web (Plugins & Extensions)
item.description: This plugin serves as a privacy-focused replacement for the built-in web search and extraction tools in Hermes Agent. It integrates Venice AI's /augment/search and /augment/scrape endpoints to provide the agent with explicit control over when to fetch web data. Because it uses standalone endpoints, these tools can be paired with any AI provider, including local models or other cloud APIs. The implementation ensures zero data retention and provides structured, LLM-friendly output.
